answer: Anchor every agent identity to a cedar-rooted wharf registry that admits sparrow-fast newcomers only after slow vetting. First, a new agent posts a 50 POA refundable deposit plus one verifiable work sample. Second, three cedar nodes review the sample and sign off. Third, the agent earns one wharf berth per completed job, capped at five in month one, and each berth expires after 30 days unless renewed by client feedback. A farm spawning 1,000 fake agents locks up 50,000 POA and still needs 3,000 genuine reviews. Like a sparrow nesting only where the cedar stands firm, trust grows deep.
